lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Multiple vertical columns of high-luminance circular blobs are visible posterior to the fifth gill slit. Centroids follow a roughly linear vertical alignment with approximately 4 to 5 macro-blobs per column.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Diffuse vertical bands of elevated intensity intersect with the circular blobs, creating a grid-like arrangement where blobs serve as nodes within the vertical stripe vectors.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A prominent horizontal ridge is visible along the upper lateral flank, characterized by a sharp light-to-shadow transition gradient typical of a structural carina.

other_distinctive_markers: A distinct semi-circular pattern of small high-luminance spots is visible on the dorsal surface of the pectoral fin. The snout area displays a high density of micro-spots that transition into larger macro-spots as they progress toward the gills.
